name: Self Esteem In Christ
overview: Scripture reveals that true self-esteem is rooted in God's intimate knowledge and purposeful creation of each person, as seen in Psalms 139 where God forms and ordains every part of us even before birth. This divine care assures believers that their worth is grounded not in themselves but in God's sustaining presence and plans for peace and hope, as affirmed in Isaiah 41 and Jeremiah 29. At the same time, Romans 12 instructs believers to maintain humility by thinking soberly about themselves, recognizing that their faith and value come from God's grace rather than personal merit.
